title: The Limits of AI Oversight
context:
## The Limits of AI Oversight

Etiquetas: Autoridad, permisos y delegación 22.22%; Control mínimo y suficiencia 33.34%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 22.22%; Evidencia, procedencia y atribución 22.22%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/sources/the-limits-of-ai-oversight-t1391/
Documento de origen: https://tegrity.ai/the-limits-of-ai-oversight/

relations.title: Tiger Team Governance Principles
relations.reading: Decision authority and timely review capacity should be specified separately in the governance contract.

relations.title: GEPLAN – Mission-Critical Logistics Intelligence for PEMEX (2006-)
relations.reading: The GEPLAN interface illustrates why human authority needs usable decision context, not merely a confirmation button.

relations.title: Rationalization.AI
relations.reading: Automation readiness should account for the review and exception-handling work that remains after routine execution is reduced.

relations.title: The Human Side of Tiger Teams
relations.reading: Trust supports collaboration, but timely review still depends on explicit decision context and actual response capacity.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.

relations.title: AI Integrity Architecture: Toward Expert-System Envelopes Around Statistical AI
relations.reading: A perfectly traceable rule chain cannot recover a decision-relevant distinction that input formation has already removed.

relations.title: Minimum Sufficient Control Architecture for AI Enabled Urban Systems
relations.reading: Control burden should be compared among configurations that meet the same objective and evidence obligations, including the human response work they create.

relations.title: The Coordination Entropy Trap in Large Scale Programs
relations.reading: Reducing decision handoffs helps only if the receiving owner retains enough context, authority and response capacity to resolve the operational case in time.

relations.title: Barcelona, Cuba, California, Veracruz: Urban Mobility, Swarm Intelligence and Constraint-Driven Architecture
relations.reading: The rejected turnstile is a field example of why control value must include its effect on the operating flow, alongside the work and risk it removes.
